caption:
Turn from your hips, not your hands. 🔄

The half-kneeling rotational chop teaches your hips and trunk to start the turn while your arms follow, the same order you want in your downswing.

✅ 3 x 8 each side with a moderate bell
✅ Bell travels on a diagonal, eyes stay level
❌ Don't lead with your arms or lock your pelvis
